The Company
Torn Banner Studios is a Toronto, Canada-based independent game development studio founded in 2010. We first made our mark with Chivalry: Medieval Warfare, a multi-million copy selling title that redefined melee combat in gaming. Since then, we’ve continued to grow and innovate, releasing Chivalry 2 and, most recently, No More Room in Hell 2. Today, our team of around 100 developers is dedicated to creating fun, cinematic and social gaming experiences.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior Technical Level Designer to join our team and help bridge the gap between Level Design and Engineering on a multiplayer game project.
In this role, you will own the technical implementation and architecture in Unreal 5 of gameplay-focused level actors and Blueprints, ensuring they are robust, scalable, maintainable, and aligned with multiplayer best practices. You will work closely with Level Designers and the Code team to translate design requirements into effective technical solutions and will help establish best practices and technical standards for a new project.
This is a senior level role
with strong technical ownership. You should be comfortable navigating the world of code, understanding technical concepts, familiar with scripting in languages like Python, Javascript or C#, and making informed technical decisions within your area of expertise.
Note: While this role can be carried out remotely, candidates are required to be current Ontario or Quebec residents or willing to relocate to Ontario.
Responsibilities

• Own the Blueprints and technical actors used by Level Design, ensuring they are well-structured, maintainable, performant, and easy for designers to use.

• Design and implement gameplay and level systems using Unreal Engine Blueprints, with a strong focus on multiplayer and network replication.

• Take ownership of systems such as destruction actors, interactive environmental objects and other reusable level gameplay actors.

• Establish and promote Blueprint best practices, particularly around multiplayer, replication, performance, reusability, and maintainability.

• Review and improve existing Blueprints and actors, ensuring they remain in good technical shape as the project evolves.

• Act as a technical bridge between Level Design and Engineering, translating design requirements into clear and effective technical solutions, tools and documentation.

• Communicate technical constraints and requirements to Level Designers and help the team make informed implementation decisions.

• Help define technical standards and workflows that allow Level Designers to work efficiently while maintaining a high level of technical quality.

• Identify technical risks and blockers within Level Design and work proactively with Engineering to resolve them.

• Contribute to the technical vision and evolution of Level Design workflows on the project.

Requirements

• Minimum 5 Years experience working with Unreal Engine in a game development environment.

• Strong understanding of Blueprint architecture and best practices.

• Experience working on multiplayer games, with a solid understanding of replication and networked gameplay concepts.

• Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into practical Blueprint solutions.

• Comfortable working closely with programmers and level designers navigating technical discussions.

• Ability to read and understand script code.

• Experience creating reusable, scalable, and maintainable gameplay or level actors.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make technical decisions within your area of ownership.

• A proactive mindset and the confidence to establish and advocate for technical best practices.

Bonus Points

• Basic familiarity with C++ or programming concepts.

• Experience with Python or other scripting languages.

Benefits & Perks

• 6.5 weeks paid vacation

• Eligible for Employee Stock Options Plan

• Flexible schedule and work location, with you

title: Litigation Paralegal
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

Be the first. Verkada’s fast-growing Legal team is hiring its first dedicated Litigation Paralegal, and you’ll have the chance to shape the role from day one. You’ll support our Litigation and Employment teams on disputes of every size and in all phases, including overseeing intake, conducting internal investigations, and handling the escalating stages of litigation from early case preparation and discovery through resolution.

You won’t just keep matters moving: You’ll build the processes, playbooks, and systems that keep our litigation docket organized as Verkada scales, and you’ll see the impact of your work right away. You’ll partner daily with in-house counsel and operations, and you’ll join a team of one to support an incredible group of lawyers.

If you love building from the ground up, this is the role for you. We’re committed to a thriving in-office culture, so this is a full-time, in-person position at our San Mateo, CA headquarters.

What You'll Do

• Manage all types of litigation matters, including handling intake, organizing and maintaining case files and records, and tracking the entire litigation docket

• Conduct internal investigations to identify relevant evidence and assess the merits of claims asserted against the company

• Manage the full lifecycle of discovery, including written discovery, document collection, privilege review, and production, working with in-house counsel, outside counsel, and outside vendors

• Draft, issue, and manage legal holds, and keep custodian and hold records current

• Respond to subpoenas and other third-party discovery requests, working with cross-functional partners to gather responsive information

• Help draft, review, and file pleadings, motions, and correspondence, and prepare exhibits and trial or hearing binders

• Calendar and track key dates and deadlines related to litigation matters

• Coordinate with outside counsel on case logistics, billing, and budget tracking

• Research and summarize factual and legal information for attorneys

• Build and maintain playbooks, templates, and processes that make the litigation function more efficient

• Partner with Legal Operations and other teams on cross-functional projects and process improvements

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• Paralegal certificate or ABA-approved paralegal program

• 4+ years of experience as a litigation paralegal, with at least 2 years working in-house at a company, ideally a technology company

• Hands-on experience managing discovery and e-discovery from collection through production

• Experience conducting or supporting internal investigations

• Proficiency with litigation management, matter management, and e-discovery tools

• Experience with commercial, IP, employment, or privacy/data security litigation and class actions
